subject: Private maintenance: escape-lane + staging quarantine proposal for May patch window
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Horvath <ben.horvath@medsecure.com>, Acme CloudOps <ops@acmecloud.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private maintenance: escape-lane + staging quarantine proposal for May patch window

Team / Ben,

We need to schedule the May maintenance for the MedSecure private deployment (VPC) to apply the 2.4.1 kernel and runtime micropatches. Before we lock in a window, I want to propose an explicit "escape lane" plus a staging-quarantine workflow so we can:

- Limit blast radius during the first 30m after cutover
- Validate traffic shaping and KV cache behavior without touching production traffic for at least one failover iteration
- Provide a single-step rollback that does not require a full data-plane redeploy

Proposal (high level):
1) Staging quarantine: direct a 10% shadow of production traffic to a quarantined staging fleet for 2 hours pre-cutover. Run the smoke/e2e probes and a single load pattern.
2) Cutover window: 02:00-04:00 PT, Fri May 21. We do node-wise upgrades, pin older model versions on a small subset (10%) for 1 hour to monitor model drift/latency.
3) Escape lane: if any of the critical SLOs (p50 latency > 400ms or error rate > 0.5%) trigger, we execute the rollback-checklist which drops routing to the upgraded slice and reattaches the pinned version.

Attachments: preflight-runbook.md (detailed checklist), rollback-checklist.pdf

Questions for the group:
- Neha: can you confirm backup/KV snapshot timing and that we can produce a quick-restore point without lasting KV starvation?
- Karthik: I need a succinct list of gating signals you want to hold the cutover for (e.g., KV miss spike, prefix cache warm rate).
- Ben: is the proposed window OK on your side? Any compliance gating (SOC2 evidence) we should attach to the maintenance record?

I will draft a short comms template for MedSecure customers and the internal on-call.

Thanks,
Olga

--
Olga Petrov
Product Operations, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Horvath <ben.horvath@medsecure.com>, Acme CloudOps <ops@acmecloud.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-05-18T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private maintenance: escape-lane + staging quarantine proposal for May patch window

Olga — thanks for the clear plan. A couple of engineering notes / asks: 

1) Gating signals (suggested, concise):
   - KV cache miss rate > 12% sustained for 3 mins
   - Prefix cache warm-up < 70% after 20 minutes on a node
   - P50 token latency increase > 120ms over baseline for 5 minutes
   - Model error distribution shift (top-5 tokens divergence > threshold)

2) Escape lane mechanics: instead of a full node roll-back, we should pump the upgraded slice into a traffic-quarantine route (NAT'd, no outbound to customers) and reattach the pinned shard to the original svc-tag. That avoids whole-cluster replays. Requires: automated remote route update (we have a Playbook in PRIVATE-4125).

3) KV snapshot: Neha, please confirm that a consistent hot-snapshot can be produced in under 8 minutes and restored to a standby cluster without cross-region replication lag impacts. If not, we should plan for a short read-only ramp for 15 minutes.

I'll prep the small automation to toggle the route for the escape lane. Also recommend a short dry run on Wed May 19 (staging only) to exercise the route toggle and rollback-checklist.

-karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Infra Lead, Serving Runtime
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Private maintenance: escape-lane + staging quarantine proposal for May patch window

Thanks Olga / Karthik — appreciate the detail. A few notes from MedSecure side: 

- Window: Fri May 21 02:00-04:00 PT works for us; we'll staff on-call and keep a point of contact (me).
- SOC2 / audit: we'll need the preflight-runbook and a signed post-maintenance evidence packet (list of commands run, timestamps, and log export). Can you include the runbook link in the ticket and tag the evidence export?
- Network: our infra team wants confirmation that the staging quarantine path will not allow egress to any external partners (explicit deny). If quarantine is implemented with a NAT, ensure routes are secured and audited.

Also, we may ask for a small extension (till 04:30) if we see delayed warmups; is that acceptable as a contingency?

Ben Horvath

Thanks — good callouts. Quick summary and named owners so we can move to a final MOP: 

Final plan (owners):
- Dry run (staging only): Wed May 19 03:00-03:30 PT — Karthik to exercise route toggle and escape-lane sequence, Neha to validate snapshot creation. (owners: Karthik, Neha)
- Production window: Fri May 21 02:00-04:00 PT, contingency to 04:30 with Ben signoff. (owner: Olga)
- Gating signals: use Karthik's list; infra automation will auto-hold if thresholds hit. (owner: Karthik)
- SOC2 evidence packet: include runbook + logs + signed checklist. I'll attach the post-maintenance evidence template to the ticket. (owner: Olga)
- Quarantine network: Acme CloudOps to confirm explicit egress-deny rule and audit logs available in 1-hour exports. (owner: Acme CloudOps)

I've attached the rollback-checklist.pdf and the comms template: maintenance-comm-template.txt. Please review and ACK by EOD so I can open PRIVATE-4125 with the docs linked.

If no major objections, I'll mark this as the official MOP and create the Jira runbook.

Olga
